name: PanWatch
description: 盯盘侠 PanWatch · 自托管 AI 盯盘助手，集成 TradingAgents 多 Agent 投资决策 | A股/港股/美股实时监控、持仓管理、智能分析、全渠道推送
one_liner: A private, self-hosted app that watches your stock portfolio around the clock and uses a team of AI analysts to argue out a buy/sell/hold decision, pushing the verdict straight to your phone.
buyer: An individual retail investor trading Chinese A-shares, Hong Kong, or US stocks who wants AI-assisted analysis on their own holdings without handing their portfolio data to a commercial platform.
business_use_cases: A retail investor self-hosts it to get a daily pre-market briefing and post-market recap on their exact holdings, pushed to Telegram or WeChat.
An independent trading educator deploys a branded instance for their community as a value-add instead of building portfolio software themselves.
A small family office uses the multi-account portfolio view to track several members' holdings privately, without a brokerage-side data leak.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, managed version for retail investors who don't want to run Docker themselves.
License a white-labeled version to independent trading educators/newsletter writers for their communities.

steal_this: Deploy it this weekend for a small group of trader friends as a shared, privately-hosted alert service and charge a flat monthly fee for hosting and upkeep.
